{
  "rule_id": "detect-sqli-002",
  "name": "SQL Injection Detection - Nginx",
  "description": "Detecta patrones de SQL Injection en request_uri de nginx",
  "index": ["filebeat-nginx-access-*"],
  "type": "query",
  "language": "kuery",
  "query": "request_uri: (*OR* or *UNION* or *SELECT* or *INSERT* or *DROP* or *--* or *%27* or *1=1*)",
  "severity": "high",
  "risk_score": 80,
  "interval": "1m",
  "from": "now-2m",
  "enabled": true,
  "tags": ["SQL Injection", "Web Attack", "OWASP"]
}

{
  "rule_id": "detect-xss-001",
  "name": "XSS Attack Detection",
  "description": "Detecta payloads sospechosos de XSS en URLs y mensajes",
  "index": ["filebeat-nginx-access-*", "filebeat-juice-shop-*"],
  "type": "query",
  "language": "kuery",
  "severity": "high",
  "risk_score": 75,
  "query": "request_uri:(*%3Cscript* or *%3Cimg* or *javascript* or *onerror* or *alert*)",
  "interval": "1m",
  "from": "now-2m",
  "enabled": true,
  "tags": ["XSS", "Web Attack", "OWASP Top 10"]
}

{
  "rule_id": "detect-cmdinj-001",
  "name": "Command Injection Detection",
  "description": "Detecta intentos de command injection en URLs",
  "index": ["filebeat-nginx-access-*"],
  "type": "query",
  "language": "kuery",
  "severity": "critical",
  "risk_score": 90,
  "query": "request_uri.keyword: *%3B* or request_uri.keyword: *%7C* or request_uri.keyword: *%60*",
  "interval": "1m",
  "from": "now-2m",
  "enabled": true,
  "tags": ["Command Injection", "Web Attack", "RCE"]
}

{
  "rule_id": "detect-bruteforce-001",
  "name": "Brute Force Login Detection",
  "description": "Detecta múltiples intentos fallidos de login en Juice Shop",
  "index": ["filebeat-nginx-access-*"],
  "type": "threshold",
  "language": "kuery",
  "severity": "high",
  "risk_score": 70,
  "query": "request_uri: \"/rest/user/login\" and status: 401",
  "interval": "1m",
  "from": "now-2m",
  "threshold": {
    "field": "remote_addr.keyword",
    "value": 5
  },
  "enabled": true,
  "tags": ["Brute Force", "Authentication", "OWASP"]
}

{
  "rule_id": "detect-scanner-001",
  "name": "Security Scanner Detection",
  "description": "Detecta tráfico de herramientas de escaneo (sqlmap, nmap, burp, nikto, etc)",
  "index": ["filebeat-nginx-access-*"],
  "type": "query",
  "language": "kuery",
  "severity": "medium",
  "risk_score": 60,
  "query": "http_user_agent: (*sqlmap* or *nmap* or *burp* or *nikto* or *python-requests* or *Nuclei* or *masscan* or *ZAP* or *Acunetix* or *Nessus*)",
  "interval": "1m",
  "from": "now-2m",
  "enabled": true,
  "tags": ["Scanner", "Reconnaissance", "Automated Attack"]
}
